title: Remove or harden MCP_DEV_TOKEN backdoor
acceptance: Static dev token cannot bypass OAuth in production; if kept, requires 32+ byte random secret, maps to a real userId (not global projectRoot), and logs a startup warning when set.
resolution: Added pure resolveDevToken (6 unit tests): rejects <32 char secrets, disables bypass under NODE_ENV=production unless MCP_DEV_TOKEN_ALLOW_PROD=true. Active token now bound to legacy user (per-user isolation, not global root). Startup logs config warnings. Example env files document the rules.
notes: Verified live: MCP_DEV_TOKEN key present in .env.docker -> after this fix the bypass is disabled in that prod deployment by default.

title: Enforce redirect_uri policy on OAuth clients (reframed from 'gate /register')
acceptance: redirect_uri must be https (or http loopback for dev), no embedded credentials, no fragment; enforced at registration AND authorize-time adoption. /register stays open (RFC 7591 DCR, ChatGPT relies on it). State file bounded against anonymous registration flooding.
resolution: Reframed after advisor + code trace: original 'gate /register behind admin' was wrong (breaks live ChatGPT connector, misses the real gap). No unauthenticated path yields a token; consent page already shows+warns about redirect destination, so this is P2 residual phishing hardening not P0. Added pure isRedirectUriAllowed (6 tests), enforced at registerClient and adoptClientFromAuthorize, plus oldest-unowned-client eviction cap. Verified policy passes live ChatGPT redirect_uris in oauth-state.json.
notes: Real mechanism was adoptClientFromAuthorize (oauth.ts:362) trusting an arbitrary redirect_uri, NOT validateAuthorizeRequest:287 (unreachable in the code-issuing path).

title: Music demo deliverables default to bundled SoundFont render
acceptance: When producing a music DEMO deliverable the workflow defaults to render_midi_with_soundfont using the bundled GeneralUser-GS pack (production_candidate) so demo audio is real instrument tone; procedural preview is used only when the user explicitly asks for a quick preview. Skill guidance steers the agent there.
notes: Not a bug: procedural=preview_only by design, no silent fallback (verified writeSoundfontRenderFailure returns ok:false, no audio). Gap is harness steering: agent stops at procedural preview though GeneralUser-GS is baked into the Docker image and recognized as production_candidate.
resolution: Real registry-to-renderer mismatch (not the earlier preview-by-design case). Added pure selectAutoRegistrablePacks (6 tests) + self-heal in resolveProductionSoundfont: discover+auto-register a license-cleared production_candidate SoundFont when no registry exists, retry once, never clobber a populated registry; unresolvable cases return the exact manage_jazz_instrument_packs call. Integration test proves render succeeds with SoundFont-in-assets + no registry.

title: Add SEO generation layer (sitemap, robots, JSON-LD, OG)
acceptance: GET /sitemap.xml and GET /robots.txt served from live blog posts + published projects; blog posts and homepage emit <script type=application/ld+json> (BlogPosting/Article) and og:/twitter: meta; verified crawlable in view-source.
notes: User-stated TOP priority. Current seo-meta-audit.ts is audit-only, generates nothing. SSR foundation already crawlable, only generation layer missing.
resolution: Added pure src/http/seo.ts (9 unit tests): buildSitemapXml, buildRobotsTxt, blog post/index head (canonical+OG+Twitter+BlogPosting JSON-LD), homepage tag injection from project metadata. New routes GET /sitemap.xml (homepage+blog index+published posts; share previews excluded) and GET /robots.txt. Blog posts/index/homepage now emit discovery+social metadata; split-host aware. Route-level test asserts tags reach served HTML + sitemap/robots crawlable. Also fixed a pre-existing stale public-api count test (commit 9440e94).

title: Stop get_blog_post leaking draft content
acceptance: get_blog_post returns draft content only to admin/author; non-privileged callers get 404 for non-published slugs.
notes: Verified: handler calls getBlogPostBySlug with no status gate, returns full JSON regardless of draft/published.
resolution: Added canViewPost gate to get_blog_post: published=public, draft visible only to author or admin. Unauthorized draft requests return the identical Not-found response as a missing slug (no existence leak). Test covers anon-hidden/admin-visible/published-public.
